### Why the Tears? - From His Heart - April 1
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/why-the-tears-from-his-heart-week-of-april-10.html
Passage: John 20:15
Points:
- Mary came to the garden overwhelmed by grief and convinced all hope was lost.
- Fixating on her pain blinded her from seeing the risen Lord standing right in front of her.
- Jesus asked about her weeping because the resurrection turns sorrow into victory.
- Believers are reminded that Christ is alive and capable of carrying any sorrow or hardship.
- Turning from despair to praise allows faith in Jesus' resurrection power to triumph over fear.

### The Garden after the Grave - The Crosswalk Devotional - April 6
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-garden-after-the-grave-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: John 20:11
Points:
- Mary arrived at the tomb seeking a corpse rather than expecting a miracle.
- Grief and tears clouded her eyes so completely that she mistook Jesus for the gardener.
- Just as humanity fell in Eden, fellowship and life are restored in this resurrection garden.
- Jesus broke through her sorrow with quiet intimacy simply by calling her name.
- Believers can take comfort that God brings new life out of apparent loss and death.
